openGaps: SOURCE EXTERNAL: Original 2021 Student Task Statements PDF / DOCX not accessible through official asset URLs; source graphic pixel and any third-party license checks not completed. Official teacher/Student Facing HTML descriptions available but not image-perfect.

A/B INTERNAL: Source-aligned Rich V2 teaching candidate and student Razor source-order fixes exist in GitHub; effective stored/published Rich V2 learner body has not been compared and source runtime/Razor rendering not verified.

C INTERNAL: All five original Student Facing prompts have distinct fields, fail-closed review responses, and individual teacher rubric rows; teacher may print/save completed work, but there is still no actual authenticated teacher decision or durable app submission, and classroom/partner performance is unverified.

C BOUNDARY: Three OPTIONAL Edulytics numeric exercises and two OPTIONAL first-party Cool-down numerics do not block submitting original source teacher-led tasks; blank is unattempted, not wrong. Publisher original Cool-down remains educator-gated and an independent equivalent is allowed.
STAGE D DEFERRED BY OWNER: xUnit/Razor/.NET tests written but must NOT be run now. Nonexecution is not itself an A–C defect.
